## PublicAllocatorOptions.reallocatableVaults property

Vaults to consider for reallocation. They must have enabled the PublicAllocator. Arrays, readonly arrays, sets, and other iterables are accepted. Defaults to all vaults present in the reallocation data.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly reallocatableVaults?: Iterable<Address>;
```
